name: hash.maphash
doc:
hash.maphash: fast seeded hashing of byte strings for hash tables
(Go's hash/maphash). The function is SipHash-1-3 (C,
runtime/src/std_hash.c): keyed, so attackers who do not know the seed
cannot craft collisions. Not a cryptographic MAC.

items.name: Bytes
items.doc: The hash of b under seed.
items.summary: The hash of b under seed.

items.name: MakeSeed
items.doc: A new random seed (from the system CSPRNG).
items.summary: A new random seed (from the system CSPRNG).

items.name: SeedFrom
items.doc: A fixed seed from 16 bytes (for reproducible hashes, e.g. in tests).
items.summary: A fixed seed from 16 bytes (for reproducible hashes, e.g. in tests).

items.name: String
items.signature: func String(seed Seed, s string) uint
items.doc: The hash of s under seed.
items.summary: The hash of s under seed.

items.name: Hash
items.doc:
A streaming maphash (hash.Hash64): buffers the input and hashes it
on Sum64, so the result equals Bytes(seed, everything written).
items.summary: A streaming maphash (hash.Hash64): buffers the input and hashes it on Sum64, so the result equals Bytes(seed, everything written).

members.name: SetSeed
members.doc: Sets the seed (otherwise a random one is chosen on first use).
members.summary: Sets the seed (otherwise a random one is chosen on first use).

members.name: Seed
members.doc: Seed returns the seed (choosing a random one on first use).
members.summary: Seed returns the seed (choosing a random one on first use).

members.name: Write
members.doc: Write adds p to the hash; it never fails.
members.summary: Write adds p to the hash; it never fails.

members.name: WriteString
members.doc: WriteString adds the bytes of s to the hash.
members.summary: WriteString adds the bytes of s to the hash.

members.name: Sum64
members.doc: Sum64 returns the hash of the bytes written.
members.summary: Sum64 returns the hash of the bytes written.

members.name: Sum
members.doc: Sum returns the hash as 8 big-endian bytes.
members.summary: Sum returns the hash as 8 big-endian bytes.

members.name: Reset
members.doc: Reset discards the bytes written (the seed stays).
members.summary: Reset discards the bytes written (the seed stays).

items.name: Seed
items.doc: A random 128-bit key. Hashes are only comparable under the same Seed.
